query:
SELECT 
  company_name,
  announcement_date,
  target_country_name,
  target_name,
  investment_type,
  deal_size_usd,
  COUNT(*) as duplicate_count
FROM investments
GROUP BY company_name, announcement_date, target_country_name, target_name, investment_type, deal_size_usd
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY duplicate_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
